rules.statement: In an architecture decision record, state the Context's forces as they hold, without describing how the code, chart or system was before the change the record decides.
rules.why: After merge, a Context that describes the earlier state seems to contradict the system the record decides on, and reads as change tracking instead of a lasting record.
rules.check: In the Context section of a new or edited decision record, look for wording that describes the earlier state of the thing the same record changes ("currently only", "wires X only as Y", "today it does not"). The same force should instead be stated in present terms that stay true after the decision.
